message: I remember the time my grandkids were convinced they could ‘outsmart’ a storm by playing hide and seek in the living room during a thunderstorm. Spoiler alert: they lost to the thunder! 🌩️ It’s a great reminder that while storms can be fascinating for little ones, it’s helpful to have some calm strategies in place. Check out the resource on thunderstorms and lightning; it’s all about staying safe while keeping that childlike wonder. What’s your favorite indoor activity during a storm?
